abstract: Although normal value of hCG (LH level) does not necessarily indicate eradication of viable trophoblast, its confirmation has been demonstrated as a clinically useful guide for the probable prevention of choriocarcinoma after hydatidiform mole by Takeuchi et al. Choriocarcinoma preceded by other pregnancies than hydatidiform mole which has the highest risk for choriocarcinoma has drawn more attention than before in connection with the decrease of postmolar choriocarcinoma. So that I have studied the regression rate of urinary gonadotropin (hCG) after the termination of various kinds of pregnancies. In 2,433 cases of induced abortion, 695 cases of spontaneous abortion, 1,724 cases of term delivery and 43 cases of hydatidiform mole, their urinary hCG were determined to the level of physiological range of LH. The rate of hCG regression was in the order of term delivery, spontaneous abortion, induced abortion and hydatidiform mole. The younger was the gestational age of trophoblast, the slower was the regression of hCG. At one month after the termination of pregnancy, 80.1%, 11%, 0.3%, 8% and 4.1%, and at two month 55.8%, 1.6%, 0.5%, 4% and 0.5% for hydatidiform mole, induced abortion of less than 12 week of gestation, spontaneous abortion of less than 12 week of gestation, spontaneous abortion of between 13 and 20 week of gestation respectively still showed abnormal hCG value. One percent of induced abortion at 5 month, 4% of spontaneous abortion at 3 month, 0.3% of term delivery at 4 month still maintained abnormal titer. No malignant sequelae in patients under the investigation have ever been observed in the follow up period between 3 and 8 years.
abstract_ja: 正常化したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値（LH値レベル）が、必ずしも生存する栄養膜の消失を示すわけではない。しかし、その確認は竹内らによって、胞状奇胎後の絨毛癌を予防するための臨床的に有用な指針であることが示された。胞状奇胎以外の妊娠後の絨毛癌は、胞状奇胎後の絨毛癌が減少したこともあり、以前にも増して注目されるようになった。そこで、各種妊娠終了後の尿中ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の消退率を検討した。人工妊娠中絶2,433例、流産695例、正期産1,724例、胞状奇胎43例において、尿中hCGを生理的範囲のLH値レベルまで測定した。hCGの消退率は、正期産、流産、人工妊娠中絶、胞状奇胎の順であった。栄養膜の妊娠週数が若いほど、hCGの消退は遅かった。妊娠終了1か月後には、胞状奇胎、12週未満の人工妊娠中絶、12週未満の流産、13〜20週の流産でそれぞれ80.1%、11%、0.3%、8%が、また2か月後には55.8%、1.6%、0.5%、4%、0.5%がなお異常なhCG値を示した。妊娠5か月の人工妊娠中絶の1%、妊娠3か月の流産の4%、妊娠4か月の正期産の0.3%が、なお異常な値を維持していた。調査対象の患者では、3〜8年のフォローアップ期間中に悪性の続発症は一度も観察されなかった。
